title: Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents
title_zh: 修复为了谁？为失败的大语言模型智能体选择修复时的评估器-执行器错配

paragraphs.en: 研究表明修复选择所用的评估器常与实际执行智能体不匹配，导致部署价值损失，修复应由执行者验证。 When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明修复选择所用的评估器常与实际执行智能体不匹配，导致部署价值损失，修复应由执行者验证。当一个 LLM 智能体失败时，修复方法需要选择替换哪个动作以及用什么来替代它。 这些方法通常用贪心重放、更强的模型、环境预言机或读取失败日志的裁判来为候选修复打分。 我们要问的是：这些评估器选出的修复是否真正有助于将要实际执行它们的智能体。 在固定失败轨迹和候选单步修复的前提下，我们用已部署策略的独立 rollout 为每个候选打标签，并测量每个评估器的选择损失了多少部署价值。 在未按修复价值筛选的失败案例上，预先设定的检验显示：相对于用已部署智能体自身的 rollout 进行选择，贪心重放在 ALFWorld 中损失 0.08–0.13 的期望净成功增益，在 WebShop 中损失 0.06–0.13 的净奖励。 在相同的 rollout 预算下，用 Qwen2.5-14B 的 rollout 为 Qwen2.5-7B 选择修复会在 ALFWorld 中损失 0.25、在 WebShop 中损失 0.07；每个候选二十次 14B rollout 的价值不超过 7B 智能体自身两次 rollout 的价值，且新的 rollout 证实在选定的分歧案例上，两个模型偏好相反的修复。 在来自不同家族、规模相近的模型之间，两个环境中的损失都呈双向出现（0.07–0.17）。 用于打分的执行器还会改变修复位置的标签以及方法排名。 修复应当用将要运行它们的执行器来验证，且修复标签应注明其执行器。
